Name: Minimalistic Cats
Author: Acc9000
Description:
It all started when I tried to draw the "Just floof, no brain" cat in a very simple style. 
It is also my first attempt of a mod with multiple config options. Happy with the result!


They can be found at the catalogue from Robin.

You can choose from:

Frame colours: Basic, Vanilla, Black, Blue, Pink, Rose gold, Wood, Dark wood
Background colours: White, Black, Blue, Pink, Off white
Cats colours: Black, White, Blue, Pink


Experiment with various combos to fit the style of your house.

Have fun!
